description: This file contains unit tests for the RecruitmentAttachmentDao class within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It tests methods related to saving, retrieving, and deleting vacancy attachment data in the recruitment module.

classes.name: RecruitmentAttachmentDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class designed to verify functionality of the RecruitmentAttachmentDao in the recruitment plugin, including CRUD operations on vacancy attachments.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, sets up the DAO object, and populates test data from a YAML fixture file.

methods.name: testSaveVacancyAttachment
methods.description: Tests the saving of a vacancy attachment and verifies the returned object and its properties.

methods.name: testGetVacancyAttachmentContentById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a vacancy attachment by ID and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testGetVacancyAttachmentsByVacancyId
methods.description: Tests retrieval of multiple attachments for a vacancy ID and verifies correctness.

methods.name: testDeleteVacancyAttachments
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple vacancy attachments by IDs and verifies their removal.
